name: Togo
summary: Five green and yellow horizontal stripes with a red canton bearing a white star. Designed by the artist Paul Ahyi, it is said to follow the golden ratio in its proportions.
origin: Togo, a UN trust territory under French administration, became independent on 27 April 1960. The artist Paul Ahyi designed the flag, adopted the same day.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: Faith in work as the basis of prosperity; also mineral wealth.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood shed for independence; also charity and love.

symbols.name: Five stripes
symbols.description: Three green and two yellow stripes.

symbols.name: White star
symbols.description: A five-pointed star in the red canton.
symbols.meaning: Life, purity and peace; the star of hope.

facts: Its proportions approximate the golden ratio, about 1:1.618.
It is one of few African flags with a canton, a layout more common in the Americas and Oceania.
clues: Green and yellow stripes with a red canton holding a white star.
Its proportions approximate the golden ratio.
Its five stripes stand for five regions.
